bug_fix_verification.issue: When editing a sale (especially converted from quote), changing product quantity did not update sale_amount_tl
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: manual_override flag was set to true when editing, preventing automatic sale_amount_tl updates
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added manual_override: false in updateItem (line 351-356) and removeItem (line 319-320) functions

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly implemented - manual_override: false added to updateItem and removeItem functions
The fix ensures that when quantity, unit_price, or item_id changes, the sale_amount_tl is automatically recalculated
The useEffect hook (lines 362-384) correctly handles the automatic update when manual_override is false
seed_data_creation: Used existing sale record: Remzi Rıdvan Çetin (TKL-202602-0039) with 8 items converted from quote
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for sale_amount_tl auto-update verified. The fix adds manual_override: false in updateItem and removeItem functions in Sales.jsx. When editing a sale, changing quantity or removing items now correctly updates the Satış Tutarı (TL) field automatically. The first sale (Remzi Rıdvan Çetin) has 8 items and was used for testing.
